extra.reason: Merged: https://github.com/Mesh-America/supply-drop-bbs/pull/248

Root cause found and fixed: /opt/supply-drop-bbs was never touched by the .deb-based upgrade (tracked separately as supply-drop-bbs-536), and once manually synced, the sync itself hit the fetch bug fixed in supply-drop-bbs-e5n / #247-248. Confirmed resolved on production (mesh-america-bbs): BBS now independently verified as Room Server via MeshCore contact details and the corescope map.
Merged: https://github.com/Mesh-America/supply-drop-bbs/pull/269

Docs-only fix: warning added to docs/OPERATIONS.md and generated pymc-companion.yaml, referencing known upstream openhop_core bug. Cannot fix upstream library from this repo; needs hardware to verify reachability, per issue's own suggested next steps.
Docs-only fix: corrected pymc-companion.yaml.example's sync_word comment to note it is currently dead code upstream (openhop_core reads it but never writes it to the radio).

Fixed: radio.begin() now wraps in try/except so RuntimeError-raising init failures get the same friendly error message as the is-False case; autoadd_config comment corrected in both pymc-companion.py and pymc-companion.yaml.example.

Fixed: docs/OPERATIONS.md's .deb-install Pi HAT callout now accurately states install.sh's guided setup is the only way to set up a Pi HAT bridge for the first time, and fixed a broken anchor link plus a stale claim about .deb updates never touching pymc-companion (no longer true since #243's self-update mechanism).

Fixed: added guestRoomNameMissing validation in SettingsPage.vue, disables Save and shows an inline error instead of silently sending guest_room:null. Also fixed a hostile-audit-found edge case (empty-string guest_room from server incorrectly treated as enabled-with-name) and consistency issues (stale success banner, inconsistent messaging, field-error class convention).

Fixed: traced the real root cause (bbs-mesh's sync_radio_params_if_configured applies [plugins.mesh.radio] on every connect regardless of connection type, but setup.rs's wizard only ever prompted for/wrote it under serial, based on a stale comment). Widened both gates to all connection types, added 4 unit tests, added HAT-specific wizard clarification about the relationship between the two region prompts (per hostile audit finding).

Fixed: Host::advert_location_state() added as an atomic combined snapshot of node_location()+share_location_in_advert(), backed by one RwLock in BbsHost (was two independently-locked fields). Both mesh advert-send paths (broadcast_self_advert, on-connect SelfInfo) and bbs-meshtastic's fixed-position sync now snapshot once instead of racing. Hostile-audited (Extractor+Concurrency, Hostile QA+Verifier); regression test verified to actually catch the reintroduced race. Residual writer-side gap tracked separately (supply-drop-bbs-2nt / #274).

Merged in PR #279 (fix/config-toml-file-locking): added bbs_core::config_lock cross-process advisory lock, extended coverage to 4 additional call sites a hostile audit found, fixed a data-loss bug and a symlink exposure.

Merged in PR #282 (fix/revert-room-server-advert-type): reverted adv_type default from Room(3) back to Chat(1) in all 3 locations, root cause confirmed against upstream MeshCore Companion Radio Protocol docs.

Merged in PR #285: builds the web frontend on the runner before the cross build steps, teaches build.rs to skip npm via BBS_WEB_SKIP_NPM_BUILD, passed through Cross.toml. Verified locally on both paths.
Merged in PR #289: migrates existing adv_type: 3 to 1 in pymc-companion.yaml, both via postinst's unattended .deb-upgrade self-update and via re-running the setup wizard.
Merged in PR #296.

Documented as accepted risk with a compensating control: a loud warning on unexpected non-fast-forward history (what a rewritten-history attack or force-push would look like). Full signed-tag verification would need release-signing infra this project doesn't have yet.
Fixed: local commits diverging from the fetched branch are now backed up to a timestamped branch before checkout -B, with a warning. Verified via executed repro.

Fixed: a repo-health probe (HEAD resolves) replaces the bare directory-existence check; an unhealthy .git triggers a clean re-clone instead of a permanent failure loop. Verified via executed repro (old logic aborts the whole script under set -e; new logic recovers).
Fixed: a non-empty non-git SRC_DIR is detected before attempting git clone and dies with an actionable message. Verified via executed repro.
Fixed: a failed self-heal fetch now warns and continues with the existing local source instead of aborting the whole script. Verified via executed repro.
Fixed: --uninstall is detected anywhere in the argument list, not just $1.
